#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report poster — refined version."""

import os
import textwrap
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, Rectangle
from matplotlib.colors import LinearSegmentedColormap
from PIL import Image
Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None

# ── Dimensions ──
A0_W_MM, A0_H_MM = 841, 1189
DPI = 150
W_IN = A0_W_MM / 25.4
H_IN = A0_H_MM / 25.4

# ── Colors ──
NAVY       = '#0B1628'
SLATE      = '#162036'
DARK_SLATE = '#1A2744'
CARD_BG    = '#1C2B47'
ACCENT_AMBER   = '#F5A623'
ACCENT_VERM    = '#E8552E'
ACCENT_RED     = '#C62828'
ACCENT_DEEP_RED= '#8B1A1A'
COOL_TEAL  = '#2AA198'
COOL_BLUE  = '#4A90D9'
TEXT_WHITE = '#EDF2F7'
TEXT_LIGHT = '#CBD5E0'
TEXT_DIM   = '#7B8BA3'

SCENARIO_COLORS = {
    'SSP1-1.9': '#2AA198',
    'SSP1-2.6': '#4A90D9',
    'SSP2-4.5': '#F5A623',
    'SSP3-7.0': '#E8552E',
    'SSP5-8.5': '#C62828',
}

FONT = 'Liberation Sans'

def txt(ax, x, y, text, fs=12, color=TEXT_WHITE, weight='normal',
        ha='left', va='bottom', style='normal', alpha=1.0, ls=1.2, ff=FONT):
    return ax.text(x, y, text, fontsize=fs, fontweight=weight, color=color,
                   ha=ha, va=va, fontstyle=style, alpha=alpha,
                   linespacing=ls, fontfamily=ff, transform=ax.transAxes)

def wrap(text, width=80):
    return '\n'.join(textwrap.wrap(text, width=width))

def draw_divider(ax, y, color=ACCENT_AMBER, alpha=0.3, lw=1):
    line = plt.Line2D([ML, ML + CW], [y, y], color=color,
                      linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha, transform=ax.transAxes, zorder=3)
    ax.add_line(line)

def draw_card(ax, x, y, w, h, edge_color=ACCENT_AMBER, lw=1.5, bg=CARD_BG, alpha=0.85):
    card = FancyBboxPatch((x, y), w, h, boxstyle="round,pad=0.004",
                          facecolor=bg, edgecolor=edge_color, linewidth=lw,
                          alpha=alpha, zorder=2)
    ax.add_patch(card)
    return card

def draw_accent_bar(ax, x, y, w, h, color):
    bar = FancyBboxPatch((x, y), w, h, boxstyle="round,pad=0.002",
                         facecolor=color, edgecolor='none', alpha=0.9, zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(bar)

# ── Layout ──
ML = 0.045       # margin left
MR = 0.045
CW = 1 - ML - MR  # content width

# ── Figure ──
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(W_IN, H_IN), dpi=DPI, facecolor=NAVY)
ax = fig.add_axes([0, 0, 1, 1])
ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax.set_facecolor(NAVY)
ax.axis('off')

# Subtle vertical gradient background
grad = np.linspace(0, 1, 256).reshape(1, -1)
grad = np.vstack([grad] * 10)
ax.imshow(grad, extent=[0, 1, 0, 1], aspect='auto',
          cmap=LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list('bg', [NAVY, SLATE, DARK_SLATE]),
          alpha=0.5, zorder=0)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════
#  HEADER
# ══════════════════════════════════════════
y = 0.965

# IPCC label bar
header_bar = FancyBboxPatch((ML, y - 0.017), CW, 0.02,
                             boxstyle="round,pad=0.003", facecolor=ACCENT_RED,
                             edgecolor='none', alpha=0.85, zorder=2)
ax.add_patch(header_bar)
txt(ax, ML + 0.012, y - 0.007,
    'IPCC  |  SIXTH ASSESSMENT REPORT  |  SYNTHESIS REPORT 2023',
    fs=17, weight='bold', color=TEXT_WHITE, va='center', alpha=0.95)

# Title
y -= 0.038
txt(ax, ML, y, 'Climate Change 2023', fs=60, weight='bold', color=TEXT_WHITE, va='top')

y -= 0.052
txt(ax, ML, y,
    'Key Findings from the IPCC Sixth Assessment Synthesis Report',
    fs=27, weight='normal', color=TEXT_LIGHT, va='top')

# Decorative line
y -= 0.024
line = plt.Line2D([ML, ML + 0.22], [y, y], color=ACCENT_VERM, linewidth=4,
                  transform=ax.transAxes, zorder=3)
ax.add_line(line)
line2 = plt.Line2D([ML + 0.23, ML + CW], [y, y], color=ACCENT_AMBER,
                   linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.35, transform=ax.transAxes, zorder=3)
ax.add_line(line2)

# One-liner
y -= 0.016
txt(ax, ML, y,
    'A visual summary of observed changes, future projections, and urgent pathways for climate action.',
    fs=15, color=TEXT_DIM, va='top', style='italic')

# ══════════════════════════════════════════
#  SEVEN HEADLINE METRICS (centerpiece)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════
y -= 0.025
txt(ax, ML, y, 'HEADLINE METRICS', fs=12, weight='bold', color=ACCENT_AMBER,
    va='top', alpha=0.9)

y -= 0.01
metrics = [
    ("1.1°C", "Global Surface\nTemperature Rise", "2011–2020 vs.\n1850–1900", ACCENT_VERM),
    ("410 ppm", "CO₂ Concentration", "Highest in 2M\nyears (2019)", ACCENT_AMBER),
    ("~59 GtCO₂e", "Global GHG\nEmissions", "Annual total\n(2019)", ACCENT_VERM),
    ("~500 GtCO₂", "Remaining\nCarbon Budget", "50% chance of\n1.5°C (from 2020)", ACCENT_RED),
    ("43%", "Required Reduction\nby 2030", "Below 2019 levels\nfor 1.5°C", ACCENT_DEEP_RED),
    ("~0.20 m", "Sea Level\nRise", "Cumulative\n1901–2018", COOL_TEAL),
    ("3.3–3.6B", "People Exposed to\nSevere Hazards", "Highly vulnerable\npopulations", ACCENT_DEEP_RED),
]

card_gap = 0.012
card_w = (CW - card_gap * 6) / 7
card_h = 0.128
card_y = y - card_h

for i, (value, label, sublabel, color) in enumerate(metrics):
    cx = ML + i * (card_w + card_gap)
    draw_card(ax, cx, card_y, card_w, card_h, edge_color=color, lw=1.5)
    draw_accent_bar(ax, cx + 0.004, card_y + card_h - 0.007, card_w - 0.008, 0.005, color)

    val_size = 30 if len(value) <= 6 else 24 if len(value) <= 9 else 21
    txt(ax, cx + card_w / 2, card_y + card_h - 0.018, value,
        fs=val_size, weight='bold', color=color, ha='center', va='top')

    txt(ax, cx + card_w / 2, card_y + card_h - 0.048, label,
        fs=10.5, weight='bold', color=TEXT_WHITE, ha='center', va='top', ls=1.15)

    txt(ax, cx + card_w / 2, card_y + 0.01, sublabel,
        fs=8.5, color=TEXT_DIM, ha='center', va='bottom', ls=1.15)

y = card_y - 0.018

# ══════════════════════════════════════════
#  01 — OBSERVED CHANGES
# ══════════════════════════════════════════
draw_divider(ax, y)
y -= 0.008
txt(ax, ML, y, '01', fs=32, weight='bold', color=ACCENT_VERM, va='top', alpha=0.35)
txt(ax, ML + 0.032, y, 'OBSERVED CHANGES AND CURRENT STATE',
    fs=20, weight='bold', color=TEXT_WHITE, va='top')

y -= 0.032
obs_lines = [
    "Human-caused climate change is already affecting every region on Earth, with widespread",
    "and intensifying consequences. Global surface temperature rose by approximately 1.1°C",
    "between 2011–2020 relative to the pre-industrial baseline. Atmospheric CO₂ reached",
    "410 ppm in 2019—the highest level in at least 2 million years. Total global greenhouse",
    "gas emissions stood at approximately 59 GtCO₂e in 2019, with fossil fuel combustion",
    "and land-use change as the dominant sources. Every region has experienced increases in the",
    "frequency and intensity of extreme weather events, including heatwaves, heavy precipitation,",
    "droughts, and tropical cyclones, with clear attribution to human influence.",
]
txt(ax, ML, y, '\n'.join(obs_lines), fs=12.5, color=TEXT_LIGHT, va='top', ls=1.5)

# Observed data table
y -= 0.135
table_data = [
    ("Global surface temperature rise", "+1.1°C", "2011–2020 vs. 1850–1900"),
    ("Atmospheric CO₂", "410 ppm", "2019"),
    ("Global GHG emissions", "~59 GtCO₂e", "2019"),
    ("Sea level rise", "~0.20 m", "1901–2018"),
    ("Arctic sea ice (Sept.) decline", "~40% area loss", "1979–2020"),
]

col_x = [ML, ML + 0.30, ML + 0.48]
col_labels = ["Indicator", "Observed Value", "Reference Period"]

# Table header
hdr_bg = FancyBboxPatch((ML, y - 0.016), CW * 0.7, 0.02,
                         boxstyle="round,pad=0.002", facecolor=ACCENT_VERM,
                         edgecolor='none', alpha=0.2, zorder=2)
ax.add_patch(hdr_bg)
for j, (label, cx) in enumerate(zip(col_labels, col_x)):
    txt(ax, cx + 0.008, y - 0.01, label, fs=10.5, weight='bold', color=ACCENT_AMBER, va='center')

y -= 0.024
for i, (ind, val, ref) in enumerate(table_data):
    row_y = y - i * 0.021
    if i % 2 == 0:
        rbg = FancyBboxPatch((ML, row_y - 0.008), CW * 0.7, 0.019,
                              boxstyle="round,pad=0.001", facecolor=CARD_BG,
                              edgecolor='none', alpha=0.35, zorder=1)
        ax.add_patch(rbg)
    txt(ax, col_x[0] + 0.008, row_y, ind, fs=10.5, color=TEXT_LIGHT, va='center')
    txt(ax, col_x[1] + 0.008, row_y, val, fs=11, weight='bold', color=ACCENT_AMBER, va='center')
    txt(ax, col_x[2] + 0.008, row_y, ref, fs=9.5, color=TEXT_DIM, va='center')

y -= len(table_data) * 0.021 + 0.015

# ══════════════════════════════════════════
#  02 — FUTURE PROJECTIONS
# ══════════════════════════════════════════
draw_divider(ax, y)
y -= 0.008
txt(ax, ML, y, '02', fs=32, weight='bold', color=ACCENT_VERM, va='top', alpha=0.35)
txt(ax, ML + 0.032, y, 'FUTURE PROJECTIONS UNDER DIFFERENT SCENARIOS',
    fs=20, weight='bold', color=TEXT_WHITE, va='top')

y -= 0.032
proj_lines = [
    "The AR6 uses Shared Socioeconomic Pathways (SSPs) to project future climate outcomes.",
    "Under the very low emissions scenario (SSP1-1.9), warming reaches ~1.4°C by 2100.",
    "Under the very high emissions scenario (SSP5-8.5), warming could exceed 4.4°C.",
    "Sea level is projected to rise by 0.28–0.55 m under SSP1-1.9 and 0.63–1.01 m",
    "under SSP5-8.5 by 2100, with continued rise for centuries regardless of pathway.",
]
txt(ax, ML, y, '\n'.join(proj_lines), fs=12.5, color=TEXT_LIGHT, va='top', ls=1.5)

ax.add_line(th2)
txt(ax, cx_r + 0.003, t2, '2°C', fs=9, color=ACCENT_VERM, va='center')

# X-axis labels
for year in [2020, 2040, 2060, 2080, 2100]:

txt(ax, (cx_l + cx_r) / 2, chart_y + 0.007,

# ══════════════════════════════════════════

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report poster — fits A0 portrait."""

import os
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch
from matplotlib.colors import LinearSegmentedColormap
from PIL import Image
Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None

# ── Dimensions ──
DPI = 150
W_IN = 841 / 25.4   # A0 width in inches
H_IN = 1189 / 25.4  # A0 height in inches

# ── Colors ──
NAVY       = '#0B1628'
SLATE      = '#162036'
DARK_SLATE = '#1A2744'
CARD_BG    = '#1C2B47'
ACCENT_AMBER   = '#F5A623'
ACCENT_VERM    = '#E8552E'
ACCENT_RED     = '#C62828'
ACCENT_DEEP    = '#8B1A1A'
COOL_TEAL  = '#2AA198'
COOL_BLUE  = '#4A90D9'
TW = '#EDF2F7'  # text white
TL = '#CBD5E0'  # text light
TD = '#7B8BA3'  # text dim

SCEN_CLR = {'SSP1-1.9': '#2AA198', 'SSP1-2.6': '#4A90D9',
            'SSP2-4.5': '#F5A623', 'SSP3-7.0': '#E8552E', 'SSP5-8.5': '#C62828'}
FF = 'Liberation Sans'

def T(ax, x, y, t, fs=12, c=TW, w='normal', ha='left', va='bottom', ls=1.2):
    return ax.text(x, y, t, fontsize=fs, fontweight=w, color=c,
                   ha=ha, va=va, linespacing=ls, fontfamily=FF, transform=ax.transAxes)

def div(ax, y, clr=ACCENT_AMBER, a=0.3, lw=1):
    ax.add_line(plt.Line2D([ML, ML+CW], [y,y], color=clr, linewidth=lw, alpha=a, transform=ax.transAxes, zorder=3))

def card(ax, x, y, w, h, ec=ACCENT_AMBER, lw=1.5, bg=CARD_BG, al=0.85):
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((x,y), w, h, boxstyle="round,pad=0.004",
                facecolor=bg, edgecolor=ec, linewidth=lw, alpha=al, zorder=2))

def bar(ax, x, y, w, h, c, al=0.9):
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((x,y), w, h, boxstyle="round,pad=0.002",
                facecolor=c, edgecolor='none', alpha=al, zorder=3))

ML = 0.04; MR = 0.04; CW = 1 - ML - MR

# ── Figure ──
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(W_IN, H_IN), dpi=DPI, facecolor=NAVY)
ax = fig.add_axes([0, 0, 1, 1])
ax.set_xlim(0, 1); ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax.set_facecolor(NAVY); ax.axis('off')

# Subtle gradient bg
g = np.linspace(0,1,256).reshape(1,-1); g = np.vstack([g]*10)
ax.imshow(g, extent=[0,1,0,1], aspect='auto',
          cmap=LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list('bg',[NAVY, SLATE, DARK_SLATE]),
          alpha=0.5, zorder=0)

y = 0.97

# ═══ HEADER ═══
hbar = FancyBboxPatch((ML, y-0.015), CW, 0.018, boxstyle="round,pad=0.002",
                       facecolor=ACCENT_RED, edgecolor='none', alpha=0.85, zorder=2)
ax.add_patch(hbar)
T(ax, ML+0.01, y-0.006, 'IPCC  |  SIXTH ASSESSMENT REPORT  |  SYNTHESIS REPORT 2023',
  fs=16, w='bold', c=TW, va='center', al=0.95)

y -= 0.033
T(ax, ML, y, 'Climate Change 2023', fs=52, w='bold', c=TW, va='top')
y -= 0.046
T(ax, ML, y, 'Key Findings from the IPCC Sixth Assessment Synthesis Report',
  fs=24, c=TL, va='top')

import matplotlib

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report poster — fits A0 portrait."""

import os
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch
from matplotlib.colors import LinearSegmentedColormap
from PIL import Image
Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None

# ── Dimensions ──
DPI = 150
W_IN = 841 / 25.4   # A0 width in inches
H_IN = 1189 / 25.4  # A0 height in inches

# ── Colors ──
NAVY       = '#0B1628'
SLATE      = '#162036'
DARK_SLATE = '#1A2744'
CARD_BG    = '#1C2B47'
ACCENT_AMBER   = '#F5A623'
ACCENT_VERM    = '#E8552E'
ACCENT_RED     = '#C62828'
ACCENT_DEEP    = '#8B1A1A'
COOL_TEAL  = '#2AA198'
COOL_BLUE  = '#4A90D9'
TW = '#EDF2F7'  # text white
TL = '#CBD5E0'  # text light
TD = '#7B8BA3'  # text dim

SCEN_CLR = {'SSP1-1.9': '#2AA198', 'SSP1-2.6': '#4A90D9',
            'SSP2-4.5': '#F5A623', 'SSP3-7.0': '#E8552E', 'SSP5-8.5': '#C62828'}
FF = 'Liberation Sans'

def T(ax, x, y, t, fs=12, c=TW, w='normal', ha='left', va='bottom', ls=1.2):
    return ax.text(x, y, t, fontsize=fs, fontweight=w, color=c,
                   ha=ha, va=va, linespacing=ls, fontfamily=FF, transform=ax.transAxes)

def div(ax, y, clr=ACCENT_AMBER, a=0.3, lw=1):
    ax.add_line(plt.Line2D([ML, ML+CW], [y,y], color=clr, linewidth=lw, alpha=a, transform=ax.transAxes, zorder=3))

def card(ax, x, y, w, h, ec=ACCENT_AMBER, lw=1.5, bg=CARD_BG, al=0.85):
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((x,y), w, h, boxstyle="round,pad=0.004",
                facecolor=bg, edgecolor=ec, linewidth=lw, alpha=al, zorder=2))

def bar(ax, x, y, w, h, c, al=0.9):
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((x,y), w, h, boxstyle="round,pad=0.002",
                facecolor=c, edgecolor='none', alpha=al, zorder=3))

ML = 0.04; MR = 0.04; CW = 1 - ML - MR

# ── Figure ──
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(W_IN, H_IN), dpi=DPI, facecolor=NAVY)
ax = fig.add_axes([0, 0, 1, 1])
ax.set_xlim(0, 1); ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax.set_facecolor(NAVY); ax.axis('off')

# Subtle gradient bg
g = np.linspace(0,1,256).reshape(1,-1); g = np.vstack([g]*10)
ax.imshow(g, extent=[0,1,0,1], aspect='auto',
          cmap=LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list('bg',[NAVY, SLATE, DARK_SLATE]),
          alpha=0.5, zorder=0)

y = 0.97

# ═══ HEADER ═══
hbar = FancyBboxPatch((ML, y-0.015), CW, 0.018, boxstyle="round,pad=0.002",
                       facecolor=ACCENT_RED, edgecolor='none', alpha=0.85, zorder=2)
ax.add_patch(hbar)
T(ax, ML+0.01, y-0.006, 'IPCC  |  SIXTH ASSESSMENT REPORT  |  SYNTHESIS REPORT 2023',
  fs=16, w='bold', c=TW, va='center', al=0.95)

y -= 0.033
T(ax, ML, y, 'Climate Change 2023', fs=52, w='bold', c=TW, va='top')
y -= 0.046
T(ax, ML, y, 'Key Findings from the IPCC Sixth Assessment Synthesis Report',
  fs=24, c=TL, va='top')
y -= 0.022
ax.add_line(plt.Line2D([ML, ML+0.20], [y,y], color=ACCENT_VERM, linewidth=3.5, transform=ax.transAxes, zorder=3))
ax.add_line(plt.Line2D([ML+0.21, ML+CW], [y,y], color=ACCENT_AMBER, linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.3, transform=ax.transAxes, zorder=3))
y -= 0.014
T(ax, ML, y, 'A visual summary of observed changes, future projections, and urgent pathways for climate action.',
  fs=13, c=TD, va='top')

# ═══ HEADLINE METRICS ═══
y -= 0.020
T(ax, ML, y, 'HEADLINE METRICS', fs=11, w='bold', c=ACCENT_AMBER, va='top', ls=1)

y -= 0.008
metrics = [
    ("1.1°C", "Global Surface\nTemperature Rise", "2011–2020 vs.\n1850–1900", ACCENT_VERM),
    ("410 ppm", "CO₂ Concentration", "Highest in 2M\nyears (2019)", ACCENT_AMBER),
    ("~59 GtCO₂e", "Global GHG\nEmissions", "Annual total\n(2019)", ACCENT_VERM),
    ("~500 GtCO₂", "Remaining\nCarbon Budget", "50% chance of\n1.5°C (from 2020)", ACCENT_RED),
    ("43%", "Required Reduction\nby 2030", "Below 2019 levels\nfor 1.5°C", ACCENT_DEEP),
    ("~0.20 m", "Sea Level\nRise", "Cumulative\n1901–2018", COOL_TEAL),
    ("3.3–3.6B", "People Exposed to\nSevere Hazards", "Highly vulnerable\npopulations", ACCENT_DEEP),
]

gap = 0.010
cw = (CW - gap*6) / 7
ch = 0.110
cy = y - ch

for i, (val, lbl, sub, clr) in enumerate(metrics):
    cx = ML + i*(cw+gap)
    card(ax, cx, cy, cw, ch, ec=clr)
    bar(ax, cx+0.003, cy+ch-0.006, cw-0.006, 0.004, clr)
    vs = 28 if len(val)<=6 else 22 if len(val)<=9 else 19
    T(ax, cx+cw/2, cy+ch-0.015, val, fs=vs, w='bold', c=clr, ha='center', va='top')
    T(ax, cx+cw/2, cy+ch-0.040, lbl, fs=9.5, w='bold', c=TW, ha='center', va='top', ls=1.12)
    T(ax, cx+cw/2, cy+0.008, sub, fs=7.5, c=TD, ha='center', va='bottom', ls=1.1)

y = cy - 0.012

# ═══ 01 OBSERVED CHANGES ═══
div(ax, y); y -= 0.006
T(ax, ML, y, '01', fs=28, w='bold', c=ACCENT_VERM, va='top')
T(ax, ML+0.028, y, 'OBSERVED CHANGES AND CURRENT STATE', fs=17, w='bold', c=TW, va='top')

y -= 0.026
obs = ("Human-caused climate change is already affecting every region on Earth, with widespread and intensifying "
       "consequences. Global surface temperature rose ~1.1°C between 2011–2020 relative to pre-industrial baseline. "
       "Atmospheric CO₂ reached 410 ppm in 2019—the highest in at least 2 million years. Total GHG emissions stood "
       "at ~59 GtCO₂e in 2019. Every region has experienced increases in extreme weather events—heatwaves, heavy "
       "precipitation, droughts, and tropical cyclones—with clear attribution to human influence.")
T(ax, ML, y, obs, fs=11, c=TL, va='top', ls=1.45)

# Mini table
y -= 0.085
tbl = [
    ("Global surface temperature rise", "+1.1°C", "2011–2020 vs. 1850–1900"),
    ("Atmospheric CO₂", "410 ppm", "2019"),
    ("Global GHG emissions", "~59 GtCO₂e", "2019"),
    ("Sea level rise", "~0.20 m", "1901–2018"),
    ("Arctic sea ice (Sept.) decline", "~40% area loss", "1979–2020"),
]

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report poster — fits A0 portrait."""

import os
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch
from matplotlib.colors import LinearSegmentedColormap
from PIL import Image
Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None

# ── Dimensions ──
DPI = 150
W_IN = 841 / 25.4   # A0 width in inches
H_IN = 1189 / 25.4  # A0 height in inches

# ── Colors ──
NAVY       = '#0B1628'
SLATE      = '#162036'
DARK_SLATE = '#1A2744'
CARD_BG    = '#1C2B47'
ACCENT_AMBER   = '#F5A623'
ACCENT_VERM    = '#E8552E'
ACCENT_RED     = '#C62828'
ACCENT_DEEP    = '#8B1A1A'
COOL_TEAL  = '#2AA198'
COOL_BLUE  = '#4A90D9'
TW = '#EDF2F7'  # text white
TL = '#CBD5E0'  # text light
TD = '#7B8BA3'  # text dim

SCEN_CLR = {'SSP1-1.9': '#2AA198', 'SSP1-2.6': '#4A90D9',
            'SSP2-4.5': '#F5A623', 'SSP3-7.0': '#E8552E', 'SSP5-8.5': '#C62828'}
FF = 'Liberation Sans'

def T(ax, x, y, t, fs=12, c=TW, w='normal', ha='left', va='bottom', ls=1.2):
    return ax.text(x, y, t, fontsize=fs, fontweight=w, color=c,
                   ha=ha, va=va, linespacing=ls, fontfamily=FF, transform=ax.transAxes)

def div(ax, y, clr=ACCENT_AMBER, a=0.3, lw=1):
    ax.add_line(plt.Line2D([ML, ML+CW], [y,y], color=clr, linewidth=lw, alpha=a, transform=ax.transAxes, zorder=3))

def card(ax, x, y, w, h, ec=ACCENT_AMBER, lw=1.5, bg=CARD_BG, al=0.85):
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((x,y), w, h, boxstyle="round,pad=0.004",
                facecolor=bg, edgecolor=ec, linewidth=lw, alpha=al, zorder=2))

def bar(ax, x, y, w, h, c, al=0.9):
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((x,y), w, h, boxstyle="round,pad=0.002",
                facecolor=c, edgecolor='none', alpha=al, zorder=3))

ML = 0.04; MR = 0.04; CW = 1 - ML - MR

# ── Figure ──
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(W_IN, H_IN), dpi=DPI, facecolor=NAVY)
ax = fig.add_axes([0, 0, 1, 1])
ax.set_xlim(0, 1); ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax.set_facecolor(NAVY); ax.axis('off')

# Subtle gradient bg
g = np.linspace(0,1,256).reshape(1,-1); g = np.vstack([g]*10)
ax.imshow(g, extent=[0,1,0,1], aspect='auto',
          cmap=LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list('bg',[NAVY, SLATE, DARK_SLATE]),
          alpha=0.5, zorder=0)

y = 0.97

# ═══ HEADER ═══
hbar = FancyBboxPatch((ML, y-0.015), CW, 0.018, boxstyle="round,pad=0.002",
                       facecolor=ACCENT_RED, edgecolor='none', alpha=0.85, zorder=2)
ax.add_patch(hbar)
T(ax, ML+0.01, y-0.006, 'IPCC  |  SIXTH ASSESSMENT REPORT  |  SYNTHESIS REPORT 2023',
  fs=16, w='bold', c=TW, va='center', al=0.95)

y -= 0.033
T(ax, ML, y, 'Climate Change 2023', fs=52, w='bold', c=TW, va='top')
y -= 0.046
T(ax, ML, y, 'Key Findings from the IPCC Sixth Assessment Synthesis Report',
  fs=24, c=TL, va='top')
y -= 0.022
ax.add_line(plt.Line2D([ML, ML+0.20], [y,y], color=ACCENT_VERM, linewidth=3.5, transform=ax.transAxes, zorder=3))
ax.add_line(plt.Line2D([ML+0.21, ML+CW], [y,y], color=ACCENT_AMBER, linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.3, transform=ax.transAxes, zorder=3))
y -= 0.014
T(ax, ML, y, 'A visual summary of observed changes, future projections, and urgent pathways for climate action.',
  fs=13, c=TD, va='top')

# ═══ HEADLINE METRICS ═══
y -= 0.020
T(ax, ML, y, 'HEADLINE METRICS', fs=11, w='bold', c=ACCENT_AMBER, va='top', ls=1)

y -= 0.008
metrics = [
    ("1.1°C", "Global Surface\nTemperature Rise", "2011–2020 vs.\n1850–1900", ACCENT_VERM),
    ("410 ppm", "CO₂ Concentration", "Highest in 2M\nyears (2019)", ACCENT_AMBER),
    ("~59 GtCO₂e", "Global GHG\nEmissions", "Annual total\n(2019)", ACCENT_VERM),
    ("~500 GtCO₂", "Remaining\nCarbon Budget", "50% chance of\n1.5°C (from 2020)", ACCENT_RED),
    ("43%", "Required Reduction\nby 2030", "Below 2019 levels\nfor 1.5°C", ACCENT_DEEP),
    ("~0.20 m", "Sea Level\nRise", "Cumulative\n1901–2018", COOL_TEAL),
    ("3.3–3.6B", "People Exposed to\nSevere Hazards", "Highly vulnerable\npopulations", ACCENT_DEEP),
]

gap = 0.010
cw = (CW - gap*6) / 7
ch = 0.110
cy = y - ch

for i, (val, lbl, sub, clr) in enumerate(metrics):
    cx = ML + i*(cw+gap)
    card(ax, cx, cy, cw, ch, ec=clr)
    bar(ax, cx+0.003, cy+ch-0.006, cw-0.006, 0.004, clr)
    vs = 28 if len(val)<=6 else 22 if len(val)<=9 else 19
    T(ax, cx+cw/2, cy+ch-0.015, val, fs=vs, w='bold', c=clr, ha='center', va='top')
    T(ax, cx+cw/2, cy+ch-0.040, lbl, fs=9.5, w='bold', c=TW, ha='center', va='top', ls=1.12)
    T(ax, cx+cw/2, cy+0.008, sub, fs=7.5, c=TD, ha='center', va='bottom', ls=1.1)

y = cy - 0.012

# ═══ 01 OBSERVED CHANGES ═══
div(ax, y); y -= 0.006
T(ax, ML, y, '01', fs=28, w='bold', c=ACCENT_VERM, va='top')
T(ax, ML+0.028, y, 'OBSERVED CHANGES AND CURRENT STATE', fs=17, w='bold', c=TW, va='top')

y -= 0.026
obs = ("Human-caused climate change is already affecting every region on Earth, with widespread and intensifying "
       "consequences. Global surface temperature rose ~1.1°C between 2011–2020 relative to pre-industrial baseline. "
       "Atmospheric CO₂ reached 410 ppm in 2019—the highest in at least 2 million years. Total GHG emissions stood "
       "at ~59 GtCO₂e in 2019. Every region has experienced increases in extreme weather events—heatwaves, heavy "
       "precipitation, droughts, and tropical cyclones—with clear attribution to human influence.")
T(ax, ML, y, obs, fs=11, c=TL, va='top', ls=1.45)

# Mini table
y -= 0.085
tbl = [
    ("Global surface temperature rise", "+1.1°C", "2011–2020 vs. 1850–1900"),
    ("Atmospheric CO₂", "410 ppm", "2019"),
    ("Global GHG emissions", "~59 GtCO₂e", "2019"),
    ("Sea level rise", "~0.20 m", "1901–2018"),
    ("Arctic sea ice (Sept.) decline", "~40% area loss", "1979–2020"),
]
cx_cols = [ML, ML+0.27, ML+0.42]
hdr_bg = FancyBboxPatch((ML, y-0.013), CW*0.62, 0.016, boxstyle="round,pad=0.002",
                         facecolor=ACCENT_VERM, edgecolor='none', alpha=0.2, zorder=2)
ax.add_patch(hdr_bg)
for j, (lb, cx) in enumerate(zip(["Indicator","Observed Value","Reference Period"], cx_cols)):
    T(ax, cx+0.006, y-0.008, lb, fs=9.5, w='bold', c=ACCENT_AMBER, va='center')

y -= 0.019
for i, (ind, val, ref) in enumerate(tbl):
    ry = y - i*0.017
    if i%2==0:
        ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((ML, ry-0.006), CW*0.62, 0.015, boxstyle="round,pad=0.001",
                     facecolor=CARD_BG, edgecolor='none', alpha=0.35, zorder=1))
    T(ax, cx_cols[0]+0.006, ry, ind, fs=9.5, c=TL, va='center')
    T(ax, cx_cols[1]+0.006, ry, val, fs=9.5, w='bold', c=ACCENT_AMBER, va='center')
    T(ax, cx_cols[2]+0.006, ry, ref, fs=8.5, c=TD, va='center')

y -= len(tbl)*0.017 + 0.010

# ═══ 02 FUTURE PROJECTIONS ═══
div(ax, y); y -= 0.006
T(ax, ML, y, '02', fs=28, w='bold', c=ACCENT_VERM, va='top')
T(ax, ML+0.028, y, 'FUTURE PROJECTIONS UNDER DIFFERENT SCENARIOS', fs=17, w='bold', c=TW, va='top')

y -= 0.024
T(ax, ML, y,
  "The AR6 uses Shared Socioeconomic Pathways (SSPs) to project future climate. Under SSP1-1.9, warming "
  "reaches ~1.4°C by 2100; under SSP5-8.5, warming could exceed 4.4°C. Sea level is projected to rise "
  "0.28–0.55 m (SSP1-1.9) to 0.63–1.01 m (SSP5-8.5) by 2100, with continued rise for centuries.",
  fs=11, c=TL, va='top', ls=1.45)

# Chart
y -= 0.075
cht_h = 0.130
cht_w = CW * 0.54
cht_x = ML
cht_y = y - cht_h

card(ax, cht_x, cht_y, cht_w, cht_h, ec=ACCENT_AMBER, lw=1, bg=DARK_SLATE, al=0.55)

cl = cht_x+0.028; cr = cht_x+cht_w-0.020
cb = cht_y+0.020; ct = cht_y+cht_h-0.015

# Grid
for t in [1,2,3,4,5]:
    ty = cb + (t/5.0)*(ct-cb)
    ax.add_line(plt.Line2D([cl,cr],[ty,ty], color=TD, linewidth=0.4, alpha=0.25, transform=ax.transAxes, zorder=3))
    T(ax, cl-0.005, ty, f'{t}°C', fs=7.5, c=TD, ha='right', va='center')

# Threshold lines
t15 = cb + (1.5/5.0)*(ct-cb)
ax.add_line(plt.Line2D([cl,cr],[t15,t15], color=ACCENT_AMBER, linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.6, linestyle='--', transform=ax.transAxes, zorder=3))
T(ax, cr+0.002, t15, '1.5°C', fs=8, c=ACCENT_AMBER, va='center', w='bold')
t2 = cb + (2.0/5.0)*(ct-cb)
ax.add_line(plt.Line2D([cl,cr],[t2,t2], color=ACCENT_VERM, linewidth=1, alpha=0.4, linestyle='--', transform=ax.transAxes, zorder=3))
T(ax, cr+0.002, t2, '2°C', fs=8, c=ACCENT_VERM, va='center')

for yr in [2020,2040,2060,2080,2100]:
    tx = cl + ((yr-2020)/80.0)*(cr-cl)
    T(ax, tx, cb-0.008, str(yr), fs=7.5, c=TD, ha='center', va='top')

T(ax, (cl+cr)/2, cht_y+0.005, 'Global Warming Projections by SSP Scenario',
  fs=8.5, w='bold', c=TL, ha='center', va='bottom')

# Scenario curves
scenarios = [
    ('SSP1-1.9', 1.1, 1.5, 1.4, SCEN_CLR['SSP1-1.9']),
    ('SSP1-2.6', 1.1, 1.6, 1.8, SCEN_CLR['SSP1-2.6']),
    ('SSP2-4.5', 1.1, 1.8, 2.7, SCEN_CLR['SSP2-4.5']),
    ('SSP3-7.0', 1.1, 2.1, 3.6, SCEN_CLR['SSP3-7.0']),
    ('SSP5-8.5', 1.1, 2.5, 4.4, SCEN_CLR['SSP5-8.5']),
]

for nm, t20, t50, t100, clr in scenarios:
    yrs = np.array([2020,2035,2050,2070,2100])
    tmps = np.array([t20, (t20+t50)/2+(t100-t20)*0.15, t50, (t50+t100)/2+(t100-t50)*0.1, t100])
    xs = cl + ((yrs-2020)/80.0)*(cr-cl)
    ys = cb + (tmps/5.0)*(ct-cb)
    lw = 2.5 if '1.9' in nm or '8.5' in nm else 1.8
    for k in range(len(xs)-1):
        ax.add_line(plt.Line2D([xs[k],xs[k+1]],[ys[k],ys[k+1]], color=clr, linewidth=lw, alpha=0.9, transform=ax.transAxes, zorder=4))
    ey = cb + (t100/5.0)*(ct-cb)
    T(ax, cr+0.002, ey, f'{nm}  ~{t100}°C', fs=7, w='bold', c=clr, va='center', ls=1.0)

# Scenario table (right)
stx = ML + cht_w + 0.015

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report poster — final version with proper text wrapping."""

import os
import textwrap
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch
from matplotlib.colors import LinearSegmentedColormap
from PIL import Image
Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None

# ── Dimensions ──
DPI = 150
W_IN = 841 / 25.4
H_IN = 1189 / 25.4

# ── Colors ──
NAVY      = '#0B1628';  SLATE     = '#162036';  DARK_SLATE = '#1A2744'
CARD_BG   = '#1C2B47';  ACCENT_AM = '#F5A623';  ACCENT_VM  = '#E8552E'
ACCENT_RD = '#C62828';  ACCENT_DR = '#8B1A1A';  COOL_TL    = '#2AA198'
COOL_BL   = '#4A90D9';  TW = '#EDF2F7';  TL = '#CBD5E0';  TD = '#7B8BA3'
SC = {'SSP1-1.9':'#2AA198','SSP1-2.6':'#4A90D9','SSP2-4.5':'#F5A623',
      'SSP3-7.0':'#E8552E','SSP5-8.5':'#C62828'}
FF = 'Liberation Sans'

# ── Helpers ──
ML = 0.04; CW = 0.92  # margin left, content width

def T(ax, x, y, t, fs=12, c=TW, w='normal', ha='left', va='bottom', ls=1.2):
    return ax.text(x, y, t, fontsize=fs, fontweight=w, color=c,
                   ha=ha, va=va, linespacing=ls, fontfamily=FF, transform=ax.transAxes)

def wrap(text, chars_per_line):
    """Wrap text to fit within poster width at given character count."""
    return '\n'.join(textwrap.wrap(text.strip(), width=chars_per_line))

def div(ax, y, clr=ACCENT_AM, a=0.3, lw=1):
    ax.add_line(plt.Line2D([ML, ML+CW], [y,y], color=clr, linewidth=lw, alpha=a, transform=ax.transAxes, zorder=3))

def card(ax, x, y, w, h, ec=ACCENT_AM, lw=1.5, bg=CARD_BG, al=0.85):
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((x,y), w, h, boxstyle="round,pad=0.004",
                facecolor=bg, edgecolor=ec, linewidth=lw, alpha=al, zorder=2))

def bar(ax, x, y, w, h, c, al=0.9):
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((x,y), w, h, boxstyle="round,pad=0.002",
                facecolor=c, edgecolor='none', alpha=al, zorder=3))

# ── Figure ──
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(W_IN, H_IN), dpi=DPI, facecolor=NAVY)
ax = fig.add_axes([0, 0, 1, 1])
ax.set_xlim(0, 1); ax.set_ylim(0, 1); ax.set_facecolor(NAVY); ax.axis('off')

# Gradient bg
g = np.linspace(0,1,256).reshape(1,-1); g = np.vstack([g]*10)
ax.imshow(g, extent=[0,1,0,1], aspect='auto',
          cmap=LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list('bg',[NAVY, SLATE, DARK_SLATE]),
          alpha=0.5, zorder=0)

y = 0.97

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
#  HEADER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((ML, y-0.015), CW, 0.018, boxstyle="round,pad=0.002",
             facecolor=ACCENT_RD, edgecolor='none', alpha=0.85, zorder=2))
T(ax, ML+0.01, y-0.006, 'IPCC  |  SIXTH ASSESSMENT REPORT  |  SYNTHESIS REPORT 2023',
  fs=16, w='bold', c=TW, va='center')

y -= 0.033
T(ax, ML, y, 'Climate Change 2023', fs=52, w='bold', c=TW, va='top')
y -= 0.046
T(ax, ML, y, 'Key Findings from the IPCC Sixth Assessment Synthesis Report',
  fs=24, c=TL, va='top')
y -= 0.022
ax.add_line(plt.Line2D([ML, ML+0.20], [y,y], color=ACCENT_VM, linewidth=3.5, transform=ax.transAxes, zorder=3))
ax.add_line(plt.Line2D([ML+0.21, ML+CW], [y,y], color=ACCENT_AM, linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.3, transform=ax.transAxes, zorder=3))
y -= 0.014
T(ax, ML, y, 'A visual summary of observed changes, future projections, and urgent pathways for climate action.',
  fs=13, c=TD, va='top')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
#  SEVEN HEADLINE METRICS (centerpiece)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
y -= 0.020
T(ax, ML, y, 'HEADLINE METRICS', fs=11, w='bold', c=ACCENT_AM, va='top')

y -= 0.008
metrics = [
    ("1.1°C",   "Global Surface\nTemperature Rise", "2011–2020 vs.\n1850–1900",    ACCENT_VM),
    ("410 ppm", "CO₂ Concentration",           "Highest in 2M\nyears (2019)",   ACCENT_AM),
    ("~59 GtCO₂e", "Global GHG\nEmissions",   "Annual total\n(2019)",          ACCENT_VM),
    ("~500 GtCO₂", "Remaining\nCarbon Budget", "50% chance of\n1.5°C (from 2020)", ACCENT_RD),
    ("43%",     "Required Reduction\nby 2030",      "Below 2019 levels\nfor 1.5°C",  ACCENT_DR),
    ("~0.20 m", "Sea Level\nRise",                 "Cumulative\n1901–2018",         COOL_TL),
    ("3.3–3.6B","People Exposed to\nSevere Hazards","Highly vulnerable\npopulations", ACCENT_DR),
]

gap = 0.010; cw = (CW - gap*6) / 7; ch = 0.108; cy = y - ch

for i, (val, lbl, sub, clr) in enumerate(metrics):
    cx = ML + i*(cw+gap)
    card(ax, cx, cy, cw, ch, ec=clr)
    bar(ax, cx+0.003, cy+ch-0.006, cw-0.006, 0.004, clr)
    vs = 27 if len(val)<=6 else 21 if len(val)<=9 else 18
    T(ax, cx+cw/2, cy+ch-0.015, val, fs=vs, w='bold', c=clr, ha='center', va='top')
    T(ax, cx+cw/2, cy+ch-0.038, lbl, fs=9.5, w='bold', c=TW, ha='center', va='top', ls=1.12)
    T(ax, cx+cw/2, cy+0.008, sub, fs=7.5, c=TD, ha='center', va='bottom', ls=1.1)

y = cy - 0.012

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
#  01 — OBSERVED CHANGES
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
div(ax, y); y -= 0.006
T(ax, ML, y, '01', fs=28, w='bold', c=ACCENT_VM, va='top')
T(ax, ML+0.028, y, 'OBSERVED CHANGES AND CURRENT STATE', fs=17, w='bold', c=TW, va='top')

y -= 0.025
obs = wrap(
    "Human-caused climate change is already affecting every region on Earth, with widespread "
    "and intensifying consequences. Global surface temperature rose ~1.1°C between 2011–2020 "
    "relative to pre-industrial baseline. Atmospheric CO₂ reached 410 ppm in 2019—the highest "
    "in at least 2 million years. Total GHG emissions stood at ~59 GtCO₂e in 2019. Every "
    "region has experienced increases in extreme weather events—heatwaves, heavy precipitation, "
    "droughts, and tropical cyclones—with clear attribution to human influence.", 115)
T(ax, ML, y, obs, fs=11, c=TL, va='top', ls=1.45)

# Data table

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report poster — final version with proper text wrapping."""

import os
import textwrap
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch
from matplotlib.colors import LinearSegmentedColormap
from PIL import Image
Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None

# ── Dimensions ──
DPI = 150
W_IN = 841 / 25.4
H_IN = 1189 / 25.4

# ── Colors ──
NAVY      = '#0B1628';  SLATE     = '#162036';  DARK_SLATE = '#1A2744'
CARD_BG   = '#1C2B47';  ACCENT_AM = '#F5A623';  ACCENT_VM  = '#E8552E'
ACCENT_RD = '#C62828';  ACCENT_DR = '#8B1A1A';  COOL_TL    = '#2AA198'
COOL_BL   = '#4A90D9';  TW = '#EDF2F7';  TL = '#CBD5E0';  TD = '#7B8BA3'
SC = {'SSP1-1.9':'#2AA198','SSP1-2.6':'#4A90D9','SSP2-4.5':'#F5A623',
      'SSP3-7.0':'#E8552E','SSP5-8.5':'#C62828'}
FF = 'Liberation Sans'

# ── Helpers ──
ML = 0.04; CW = 0.92  # margin left, content width

def T(ax, x, y, t, fs=12, c=TW, w='normal', ha='left', va='bottom', ls=1.2):
    return ax.text(x, y, t, fontsize=fs, fontweight=w, color=c,
                   ha=ha, va=va, linespacing=ls, fontfamily=FF, transform=ax.transAxes)

def wrap(text, chars_per_line):
    """Wrap text to fit within poster width at given character count."""
    return '\n'.join(textwrap.wrap(text.strip(), width=chars_per_line))

def div(ax, y, clr=ACCENT_AM, a=0.3, lw=1):
    ax.add_line(plt.Line2D([ML, ML+CW], [y,y], color=clr, linewidth=lw, alpha=a, transform=ax.transAxes, zorder=3))

def card(ax, x, y, w, h, ec=ACCENT_AM, lw=1.5, bg=CARD_BG, al=0.85):
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((x,y), w, h, boxstyle="round,pad=0.004",
                facecolor=bg, edgecolor=ec, linewidth=lw, alpha=al, zorder=2))

def bar(ax, x, y, w, h, c, al=0.9):
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((x,y), w, h, boxstyle="round,pad=0.002",
                facecolor=c, edgecolor='none', alpha=al, zorder=3))

# ── Figure ──
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(W_IN, H_IN), dpi=DPI, facecolor=NAVY)
ax = fig.add_axes([0, 0, 1, 1])
ax.set_xlim(0, 1); ax.set_ylim(0, 1); ax.set_facecolor(NAVY); ax.axis('off')

# Gradient bg
g = np.linspace(0,1,256).reshape(1,-1); g = np.vstack([g]*10)
ax.imshow(g, extent=[0,1,0,1], aspect='auto',
          cmap=LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list('bg',[NAVY, SLATE, DARK_SLATE]),
          alpha=0.5, zorder=0)

y = 0.97

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
#  HEADER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((ML, y-0.015), CW, 0.018, boxstyle="round,pad=0.002",
             facecolor=ACCENT_RD, edgecolor='none', alpha=0.85, zorder=2))
T(ax, ML+0.01, y-0.006, 'IPCC  |  SIXTH ASSESSMENT REPORT  |  SYNTHESIS REPORT 2023',
  fs=16, w='bold', c=TW, va='center')

y -= 0.033
T(ax, ML, y, 'Climate Change 2023', fs=52, w='bold', c=TW, va='top')
y -= 0.046
T(ax, ML, y, 'Key Findings from the IPCC Sixth Assessment Synthesis Report',
  fs=24, c=TL, va='top')
y -= 0.022
ax.add_line(plt.Line2D([ML, ML+0.20], [y,y], color=ACCENT_VM, linewidth=3.5, transform=ax.transAxes, zorder=3))
ax.add_line(plt.Line2D([ML+0.21, ML+CW], [y,y], color=ACCENT_AM, linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.3, transform=ax.transAxes, zorder=3))
y -= 0.014
T(ax, ML, y, 'A visual summary of observed changes, future projections, and urgent pathways for climate action.',
  fs=13, c=TD, va='top')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
#  SEVEN HEADLINE METRICS (centerpiece)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
y -= 0.020
T(ax, ML, y, 'HEADLINE METRICS', fs=11, w='bold', c=ACCENT_AM, va='top')

y -= 0.008
metrics = [
    ("1.1°C",   "Global Surface\nTemperature Rise", "2011–2020 vs.\n1850–1900",    ACCENT_VM),
    ("410 ppm", "CO₂ Concentration",           "Highest in 2M\nyears (2019)",   ACCENT_AM),
    ("~59 GtCO₂e", "Global GHG\nEmissions",   "Annual total\n(2019)",          ACCENT_VM),
    ("~500 GtCO₂", "Remaining\nCarbon Budget", "50% chance of\n1.5°C (from 2020)", ACCENT_RD),
    ("43%",     "Required Reduction\nby 2030",      "Below 2019 levels\nfor 1.5°C",  ACCENT_DR),
    ("~0.20 m", "Sea Level\nRise",                 "Cumulative\n1901–2018",         COOL_TL),
    ("3.3–3.6B","People Exposed to\nSevere Hazards","Highly vulnerable\npopulations", ACCENT_DR),
]

gap = 0.010; cw = (CW - gap*6) / 7; ch = 0.108; cy = y - ch

for i, (val, lbl, sub, clr) in enumerate(metrics):
    cx = ML + i*(cw+gap)
    card(ax, cx, cy, cw, ch, ec=clr)
    bar(ax, cx+0.003, cy+ch-0.006, cw-0.006, 0.004, clr)
    vs = 27 if len(val)<=6 else 21 if len(val)<=9 else 18
    T(ax, cx+cw/2, cy+ch-0.015, val, fs=vs, w='bold', c=clr, ha='center', va='top')
    T(ax, cx+cw/2, cy+ch-0.038, lbl, fs=9.5, w='bold', c=TW, ha='center', va='top', ls=1.12)
    T(ax, cx+cw/2, cy+0.008, sub, fs=7.5, c=TD, ha='center', va='bottom', ls=1.1)

y = cy - 0.012

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
#  01 — OBSERVED CHANGES
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
div(ax, y); y -= 0.006
T(ax, ML, y, '01', fs=28, w='bold', c=ACCENT_VM, va='top')
T(ax, ML+0.028, y, 'OBSERVED CHANGES AND CURRENT STATE', fs=17, w='bold', c=TW, va='top')

y -= 0.025
obs = wrap(
    "Human-caused climate change is already affecting every region on Earth, with widespread "
    "and intensifying consequences. Global surface temperature rose ~1.1°C between 2011–2020 "
    "relative to pre-industrial baseline. Atmospheric CO₂ reached 410 ppm in 2019—the highest "
    "in at least 2 million years. Total GHG emissions stood at ~59 GtCO₂e in 2019. Every "
    "region has experienced increases in extreme weather events—heatwaves, heavy precipitation, "
    "droughts, and tropical cyclones—with clear attribution to human influence.", 115)
T(ax, ML, y, obs, fs=11, c=TL, va='top', ls=1.45)

# Data table
y -= 0.090
tbl = [
    ("Global surface temperature rise", "+1.1°C", "2011–2020 vs. 1850–1900"),
    ("Atmospheric CO₂",                  "410 ppm", "2019"),
    ("Global GHG emissions",             "~59 GtCO₂e", "2019"),
    ("Sea level rise",                   "~0.20 m", "1901–2018"),
    ("Arctic sea ice (Sept.) decline",   "~40% area loss", "1979–2020"),
]
cc = [ML, ML+0.27, ML+0.42]
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((ML, y-0.013), CW*0.60, 0.016, boxstyle="round,pad=0.002",
             facecolor=ACCENT_VM, edgecolor='none', alpha=0.2, zorder=2))
for j,(lb,cx) in enumerate(zip(["Indicator","Observed Value","Reference Period"], cc)):
    T(ax, cx+0.006, y-0.008, lb, fs=9.5, w='bold', c=ACCENT_AM, va='center')
y -= 0.019
for i,(ind,val,ref) in enumerate(tbl):
    ry = y - i*0.017
    if i%2==0:
        ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((ML, ry-0.006), CW*0.60, 0.015, boxstyle="round,pad=0.001",
                     facecolor=CARD_BG, edgecolor='none', alpha=0.35, zorder=1))
    T(ax, cc[0]+0.006, ry, ind, fs=9.5, c=TL, va='center')
    T(ax, cc[1]+0.006, ry, val, fs=9.5, w='bold', c=ACCENT_AM, va='center')
    T(ax, cc[2]+0.006, ry, ref, fs=8.5, c=TD, va='center')

y -= len(tbl)*0.017 + 0.010

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
#  02 — FUTURE PROJECTIONS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
div(ax, y); y -= 0.006
T(ax, ML, y, '02', fs=28, w='bold', c=ACCENT_VM, va='top')
T(ax, ML+0.028, y, 'FUTURE PROJECTIONS UNDER DIFFERENT SCENARIOS', fs=17, w='bold', c=TW, va='top')

y -= 0.024
T(ax, ML, y, wrap(
    "The AR6 uses Shared Socioeconomic Pathways (SSPs) to project future climate. "
    "Under SSP1-1.9, warming reaches ~1.4°C by 2100; under SSP5-8.5, warming could "
    "exceed 4.4°C. Sea level is projected to rise 0.28–0.55 m (SSP1-1.9) to 0.63–1.01 m "
    "(SSP5-8.5) by 2100, with continued rise for centuries regardless of pathway.", 115),
  fs=11, c=TL, va='top', ls=1.45)

# SSP Chart
y -= 0.075
cht_h = 0.125; cht_w = CW*0.54; cht_x = ML; cht_y = y - cht_h
card(ax, cht_x, cht_y, cht_w, cht_h, ec=ACCENT_AM, lw=1, bg=DARK_SLATE, al=0.55)

cl = cht_x+0.028; cr = cht_x+cht_w-0.020; cb = cht_y+0.020; ct = cht_y+cht_h-0.015

for t in [1,2,3,4,5]:
    ty = cb + (t/5.0)*(ct-cb)
    ax.add_line(plt.Line2D([cl,cr],[ty,ty], color=TD, linewidth=0.4, alpha=0.25, transform=ax.transAxes, zorder=3))
    T(ax, cl-0.005, ty, f'{t}°C', fs=7.5, c=TD, ha='right', va='center')

t15 = cb + (1.5/5.0)*(ct-cb)
ax.add_line(plt.Line2D([cl,cr],[t15,t15], color=ACCENT_AM, linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.6, linestyle='--', transform=ax.transAxes, zorder=3))
T(ax, cr+0.003, t15, '1.5°C', fs=8, c=ACCENT_AM, va='center', w='bold')
t2 = cb + (2.0/5.0)*(ct-cb)
ax.add_line(plt.Line2D([cl,cr],[t2,t2], color=ACCENT_VM, linewidth=1, alpha=0.4, linestyle='--', transform=ax.transAxes, zorder=3))
T(ax, cr+0.003, t2, '2°C', fs=8, c=ACCENT_VM, va='center')

for yr in [2020,2040,2060,2080,2100]:
    tx = cl + ((yr-2020)/80.0)*(cr-cl)
    T(ax, tx, cb-0.008, str(yr), fs=7.5, c=TD, ha='center', va='top')

T(ax, (cl+cr)/2, cht_y+0.005, 'Global Warming Projections by SSP Scenario',
  fs=8.5, w='bold', c=TL, ha='center', va='bottom')

# Diverging pathway curves
scenarios = [
    ('SSP1-1.9', 1.1, 1.5, 1.4, SC['SSP1-1.9']),
    ('SSP1-2.6', 1.1, 1.6, 1.8, SC['SSP1-2.6']),
    ('SSP2-4.5', 1.1, 1.8, 2.7, SC['SSP2-4.5']),
    ('SSP3-7.0', 1.1, 2.1, 3.6, SC['SSP3-7.0']),
    ('SSP5-8.5', 1.1, 2.5, 4.4, SC['SSP5-8.5']),
]

for nm, t20, t50, t100, clr in scenarios:
    yrs = np.array([2020,2035,2050,2070,2100])
    tmps = np.array([t20, (t20+t50)/2+(t100-t20)*0.15, t50, (t50+t100)/2+(t100-t50)*0.1, t100])
    xs = cl + ((yrs-2020)/80.0)*(cr-cl)
    ys = cb + (tmps/5.0)*(ct-cb)
    lw = 2.5 if '1.9' in nm or '8.5' in nm else 1.8
    for k in range(len(xs)-1):
        ax.add_line(plt.Line2D([xs[k],xs[k+1]],[ys[k],ys[k+1]], color=clr, linewidth=lw, alpha=0.9, transform=ax.transAxes, zorder=4))
    ey = cb + (t100/5.0)*(ct-cb)
    T(ax, cr+0.003, ey, f'{nm}  ~{t100}°C', fs=7, w='bold', c=clr, va='center', ls=1.0)

# Scenario summary table (right)
stx = ML + cht_w + 0.015
T(ax, stx, y, 'Scenario Summary', fs=12, w='bold', c=TW, va='top')

strip = [
    ('SSP1-1.9','~1.4°C','SLR 0.28–0.55 m','Very low emissions', SC['SSP1-1.9']),
    ('SSP1-2.6','~1.8°C','SLR 0.32–0.63 m','Low emissions', SC['SSP1-2.6']),
    ('SSP2-4.5','~2.7°C','SLR 0.44–0.76 m','Intermediate', SC['SSP2-4.5']),
    ('SSP3-7.0','~3.6°C','SLR 0.56–0.98 m','High emissions', SC['SSP3-7.0']),
    ('SSP5-8.5','~4.4°C','SLR 0.63–1.01 m','Fossil-fuel intensive', SC['SSP5-8.5']),
]

sy = y - 0.024; rh = 0.020
for i, (ssp, tmp, slr, desc, clr) in enumerate(strip):
    ry = sy - i*rh
    bar(ax, stx, ry-0.004, 0.004, rh-0.003, clr)
    T(ax, stx+0.008, ry+0.002, ssp, fs=9.5, w='bold', c=clr, va='center')
    T(ax, stx+0.065, ry+0.002, tmp, fs=9.5, w='bold', c=TW, va='center')
    T(ax, stx+0.10, ry+0.002, slr, fs=8, c=TD, va='center')
    T(ax, stx+0.185, ry+0.002, desc, fs=8, c=TD, va='center')

y = cht_y - 0.010

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
#  03 — RISKS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
div(ax, y); y -= 0.006
T(ax, ML, y, '03', fs=28, w='bold', c=ACCENT_VM, va='top')
T(ax, ML+0.028, y, 'RISKS, VULNERABILITIES, AND CASCADING IMPACTS', fs=17, w='bold', c=TW, va='top')

y -= 0.028
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((ML, y-0.028), 0.34, 0.032, boxstyle="round,pad=0.004",
             facecolor=ACCENT_DR, edgecolor='none', alpha=0.35, zorder=2))
T(ax, ML+0.010, y-0.002, '3.3–3.6 billion people', fs=22, w='bold', c=ACCENT_VM, va='top')
T(ax, ML+0.010, y-0.020, 'live in contexts highly vulnerable to climate change', fs=10.5, c=TL, va='top')

# Risk cards
y -= 0.042
rcs = [
    ("FOOD SECURITY","Crop yield growth rates slowed\nin many regions. Fisheries\nproductivity declining in\ntropical zones.", ACCENT_AM),
    ("WATER STRESS","Over half the world's population\nexperiences severe water scarcity\nfor at least one month per year.", COOL_BL),
    ("HEALTH","Heat-related mortality and\nvector-borne disease ranges\nare expanding with rising\ntemperatures.", ACCENT_VM),
]
rcg = 0.010; rcw = (CW-rcg*2)/3; rch = 0.060
for i, (t, d, clr) in enumerate(rcs):
    cx = ML + i*(rcw+rcg)
    card(ax, cx, y-rch, rcw, rch, ec=clr)
    bar(ax, cx+0.003, y-0.003, rcw-0.006, 0.004, clr)
    T(ax, cx+0.010, y-0.012, t, fs=11, w='bold', c=clr, va='top')
    T(ax, cx+0.010, y-0.024, d, fs=8.5, c=TL, va='top', ls=1.3)

y -= rch + 0.010
T(ax, ML, y, wrap(
    "Biodiversity loss accelerates beyond 1.5°C — up to 14% of terrestrial species face very high "
    "extinction risk at 1.5°C, rising sharply at higher levels. Climate hazards interact with "
    "non-climatic stressors—poverty, inequality, ecosystem degradation—to produce cascading "
    "and compounding risks.", 120),
  fs=10.5, c=TL, va='top', ls=1.4)

y -= 0.050

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
#  04 — MITIGATION
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
div(ax, y); y -= 0.006
T(ax, ML, y, '04', fs=28, w='bold', c=ACCENT_VM, va='top')
T(ax, ML+0.028, y, 'MITIGATION AND ADAPTATION PATHWAYS', fs=17, w='bold', c=TW, va='top')

y -= 0.025
pw = [
    ("1.5°C PATHWAY","43% reduction by 2030","Net zero CO₂ by ~2050", ACCENT_VM, "~500 GtCO₂ remaining budget (50% likelihood)"),
    ("2°C PATHWAY","27% reduction by 2030","Net zero CO₂ by ~2070", ACCENT_AM, "Larger but still constrained carbon budget"),
]
pg = 0.012; pcw = (CW-pg)/2; pch = 0.058
for i, (t, t1, t2, clr, bgt) in enumerate(pw):
    cx = ML + i*(pcw+pg)
    card(ax, cx, y-pch, pcw, pch, ec=clr, lw=2)
    T(ax, cx+0.012, y-0.006, t, fs=13, w='bold', c=clr, va='top')
    T(ax, cx+0.012, y-0.020, t1, fs=11.5, w='bold', c=TW, va='top')
    T(ax, cx+0.012, y-0.032, t2, fs=11.5, w='bold', c=TW, va='top')
    T(ax, cx+0.012, y-0.048, bgt, fs=9, c=TD, va='top')

y -= pch + 0.012
T(ax, ML, y, 'Key Mitigation Levers', fs=12, w='bold', c=COOL_TL, va='top')
y -= 0.016
levers = ["Rapid decarbonization\nof energy systems","Electrification\nof transport",
          "Demand-side efficiency\nimprovements","Protection & restoration\nof carbon sinks"]
lg = 0.008; lvw = (CW-lg*3)/4; lvh = 0.025
for i, lv in enumerate(levers):
    lx = ML + i*(lvw+lg)
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((lx, y-lvh), lvw, lvh, boxstyle="round,pad=0.003",
                facecolor=COOL_TL, edgecolor='none', alpha=0.12, zorder=2))
    T(ax, lx+lvw/2, y-lvh/2, lv, fs=9, c=COOL_TL, ha='center', va='center', w='bold', ls=1.15)

y -= lvh + 0.012

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
#  05 — NARROWING WINDOW
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
div(ax, y, clr=ACCENT_RD, a=0.5, lw=2); y -= 0.006
T(ax, ML, y, '05', fs=28, w='bold', c=ACCENT_RD, va='top')
T(ax, ML+0.028, y, 'THE NARROWING WINDOW FOR ACTION', fs=17, w='bold', c=ACCENT_RD, va='top')

y -= 0.025
T(ax, ML, y, wrap(
    "The choices made in this decade will determine whether warming can be held to 1.5°C or 2°C. "
    "Delayed action increases costs, locks in high-carbon infrastructure, and reduces feasibility. "
    "Climate finance flows remain insufficient—falling short by a factor of 3 to 6 for adaptation alone.", 115),
  fs=11, c=TL, va='top', ls=1.45)

# Urgency callout
y -= 0.060

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report poster — final version with proper text wrapping."""

import os
import textwrap
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch
from matplotlib.colors import LinearSegmentedColormap
from PIL import Image
Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None

# ── Dimensions ──
DPI = 150
W_IN = 841 / 25.4
H_IN = 1189 / 25.4

# ── Colors ──
NAVY      = '#0B1628';  SLATE     = '#162036';  DARK_SLATE = '#1A2744'
CARD_BG   = '#1C2B47';  ACCENT_AM = '#F5A623';  ACCENT_VM  = '#E8552E'
ACCENT_RD = '#C62828';  ACCENT_DR = '#8B1A1A';  COOL_TL    = '#2AA198'
COOL_BL   = '#4A90D9';  TW = '#EDF2F7';  TL = '#CBD5E0';  TD = '#7B8BA3'
SC = {'SSP1-1.9':'#2AA198','SSP1-2.6':'#4A90D9','SSP2-4.5':'#F5A623',
      'SSP3-7.0':'#E8552E','SSP5-8.5':'#C62828'}
FF = 'Liberation Sans'

# ── Helpers ──
ML = 0.04; CW = 0.92  # margin left, content width

def T(ax, x, y, t, fs=12, c=TW, w='normal', ha='left', va='bottom', ls=1.2):
    return ax.text(x, y, t, fontsize=fs, fontweight=w, color=c,
                   ha=ha, va=va, linespacing=ls, fontfamily=FF, transform=ax.transAxes)

def wrap(text, chars_per_line):
    """Wrap text to fit within poster width at given character count."""
    return '\n'.join(textwrap.wrap(text.strip(), width=chars_per_line))

def div(ax, y, clr=ACCENT_AM, a=0.3, lw=1):
    ax.add_line(plt.Line2D([ML, ML+CW], [y,y], color=clr, linewidth=lw, alpha=a, transform=ax.transAxes, zorder=3))

def card(ax, x, y, w, h, ec=ACCENT_AM, lw=1.5, bg=CARD_BG, al=0.85):
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((x,y), w, h, boxstyle="round,pad=0.004",
                facecolor=bg, edgecolor=ec, linewidth=lw, alpha=al, zorder=2))

def bar(ax, x, y, w, h, c, al=0.9):
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((x,y), w, h, boxstyle="round,pad=0.002",
                facecolor=c, edgecolor='none', alpha=al, zorder=3))

# ── Figure ──
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(W_IN, H_IN), dpi=DPI, facecolor=NAVY)
ax = fig.add_axes([0, 0, 1, 1])
ax.set_xlim(0, 1); ax.set_ylim(0, 1); ax.set_facecolor(NAVY); ax.axis('off')

# Gradient bg
g = np.linspace(0,1,256).reshape(1,-1); g = np.vstack([g]*10)
ax.imshow(g, extent=[0,1,0,1], aspect='auto',
          cmap=LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list('bg',[NAVY, SLATE, DARK_SLATE]),
          alpha=0.5, zorder=0)

y = 0.97

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
#  HEADER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((ML, y-0.015), CW, 0.018, boxstyle="round,pad=0.002",
             facecolor=ACCENT_RD, edgecolor='none', alpha=0.85, zorder=2))
T(ax, ML+0.01, y-0.006, 'IPCC  |  SIXTH ASSESSMENT REPORT  |  SYNTHESIS REPORT 2023',
  fs=16, w='bold', c=TW, va='center')

y -= 0.033
T(ax, ML, y, 'Climate Change 2023', fs=52, w='bold', c=TW, va='top')
y -= 0.046
T(ax, ML, y, 'Key Findings from the IPCC Sixth Assessment Synthesis Report',
  fs=24, c=TL, va='top')
y -= 0.022
ax.add_line(plt.Line2D([ML, ML+0.20], [y,y], color=ACCENT_VM, linewidth=3.5, transform=ax.transAxes, zorder=3))
ax.add_line(plt.Line2D([ML+0.21, ML+CW], [y,y], color=ACCENT_AM, linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.3, transform=ax.transAxes, zorder=3))
y -= 0.014
T(ax, ML, y, 'A visual summary of observed changes, future projections, and urgent pathways for climate action.',
  fs=13, c=TD, va='top')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
#  SEVEN HEADLINE METRICS (centerpiece)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
y -= 0.020
T(ax, ML, y, 'HEADLINE METRICS', fs=11, w='bold', c=ACCENT_AM, va='top')

y -= 0.008
metrics = [
    ("1.1°C",   "Global Surface\nTemperature Rise", "2011–2020 vs.\n1850–1900",    ACCENT_VM),
    ("410 ppm", "CO₂ Concentration",           "Highest in 2M\nyears (2019)",   ACCENT_AM),
    ("~59 GtCO₂e", "Global GHG\nEmissions",   "Annual total\n(2019)",          ACCENT_VM),
    ("~500 GtCO₂", "Remaining\nCarbon Budget", "50% chance of\n1.5°C (from 2020)", ACCENT_RD),
    ("43%",     "Required Reduction\nby 2030",      "Below 2019 levels\nfor 1.5°C",  ACCENT_DR),
    ("~0.20 m", "Sea Level\nRise",                 "Cumulative\n1901–2018",         COOL_TL),
    ("3.3–3.6B","People Exposed to\nSevere Hazards","Highly vulnerable\npopulations", ACCENT_DR),
]

gap = 0.010; cw = (CW - gap*6) / 7; ch = 0.108; cy = y - ch

for i, (val, lbl, sub, clr) in enumerate(metrics):
    cx = ML + i*(cw+gap)
    card(ax, cx, cy, cw, ch, ec=clr)
    bar(ax, cx+0.003, cy+ch-0.006, cw-0.006, 0.004, clr)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report poster — final version with proper text wrapping."""

import os
import textwrap
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch
from matplotlib.colors import LinearSegmentedColormap
from PIL import Image
Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None

# ── Dimensions ──
DPI = 150
W_IN = 841 / 25.4
H_IN = 1189 / 25.4

# ── Colors ──
NAVY      = '#0B1628';  SLATE     = '#162036';  DARK_SLATE = '#1A2744'
CARD_BG   = '#1C2B47';  ACCENT_AM = '#F5A623';  ACCENT_VM  = '#E8552E'
ACCENT_RD = '#C62828';  ACCENT_DR = '#8B1A1A';  COOL_TL    = '#2AA198'
COOL_BL   = '#4A90D9';  TW = '#EDF2F7';  TL = '#CBD5E0';  TD = '#7B8BA3'
SC = {'SSP1-1.9':'#2AA198','SSP1-2.6':'#4A90D9','SSP2-4.5':'#F5A623',
      'SSP3-7.0':'#E8552E','SSP5-8.5':'#C62828'}
FF = 'Liberation Sans'

# ── Helpers ──
ML = 0.04; CW = 0.92  # margin left, content width

def T(ax, x, y, t, fs=12, c=TW, w='normal', ha='left', va='bottom', ls=1.2):
    return ax.text(x, y, t, fontsize=fs, fontweight=w, color=c,
                   ha=ha, va=va, linespacing=ls, fontfamily=FF, transform=ax.transAxes)

def wrap(text, chars_per_line):
    """Wrap text to fit within poster width at given character count."""
    return '\n'.join(textwrap.wrap(text.strip(), width=chars_per_line))

def div(ax, y, clr=ACCENT_AM, a=0.3, lw=1):
    ax.add_line(plt.Line2D([ML, ML+CW], [y,y], color=clr, linewidth=lw, alpha=a, transform=ax.transAxes, zorder=3))

def card(ax, x, y, w, h, ec=ACCENT_AM, lw=1.5, bg=CARD_BG, al=0.85):
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((x,y), w, h, boxstyle="round,pad=0.004",
                facecolor=bg, edgecolor=ec, linewidth=lw, alpha=al, zorder=2))

def bar(ax, x, y, w, h, c, al=0.9):
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((x,y), w, h, boxstyle="round,pad=0.002",
                facecolor=c, edgecolor='none', alpha=al, zorder=3))

# ── Figure ──
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(W_IN, H_IN), dpi=DPI, facecolor=NAVY)
ax = fig.add_axes([0, 0, 1, 1])
ax.set_xlim(0, 1); ax.set_ylim(0, 1); ax.set_facecolor(NAVY); ax.axis('off')

# Gradient bg
g = np.linspace(0,1,256).reshape(1,-1); g = np.vstack([g]*10)
ax.imshow(g, extent=[0,1,0,1], aspect='auto',
          cmap=LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list('bg',[NAVY, SLATE, DARK_SLATE]),
          alpha=0.5, zorder=0)

y = 0.97

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
#  HEADER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((ML, y-0.015), CW, 0.018, boxstyle="round,pad=0.002",
             facecolor=ACCENT_RD, edgecolor='none', alpha=0.85, zorder=2))
T(ax, ML+0.01, y-0.006, 'IPCC  |  SIXTH ASSESSMENT REPORT  |  SYNTHESIS REPORT 2023',
  fs=16, w='bold', c=TW, va='center')

y -= 0.033
T(ax, ML, y, 'Climate Change 2023', fs=52, w='bold', c=TW, va='top')
y -= 0.046
T(ax, ML, y, 'Key Findings from the IPCC Sixth Assessment Synthesis Report',
  fs=24, c=TL, va='top')
y -= 0.022
ax.add_line(plt.Line2D([ML, ML+0.20], [y,y], color=ACCENT_VM, linewidth=3.5, transform=ax.transAxes, zorder=3))
ax.add_line(plt.Line2D([ML+0.21, ML+CW], [y,y], color=ACCENT_AM, linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.3, transform=ax.transAxes, zorder=3))
y -= 0.014
T(ax, ML, y, 'A visual summary of observed changes, future projections, and urgent pathways for climate action.',
  fs=13, c=TD, va='top')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
#  SEVEN HEADLINE METRICS (centerpiece)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
y -= 0.020
T(ax, ML, y, 'HEADLINE METRICS', fs=11, w='bold', c=ACCENT_AM, va='top')

y -= 0.008
metrics = [
    ("1.1°C",   "Global Surface\nTemperature Rise", "2011–2020 vs.\n1850–1900",    ACCENT_VM),
    ("410 ppm", "CO₂ Concentration",           "Highest in 2M\nyears (2019)",   ACCENT_AM),
    ("~59 GtCO₂e", "Global GHG\nEmissions",   "Annual total\n(2019)",          ACCENT_VM),
    ("~500 GtCO₂", "Remaining\nCarbon Budget", "50% chance of\n1.5°C (from 2020)", ACCENT_RD),
    ("43%",     "Required Reduction\nby 2030",      "Below 2019 levels\nfor 1.5°C",  ACCENT_DR),
    ("~0.20 m", "Sea Level\nRise",                 "Cumulative\n1901–2018",         COOL_TL),
    ("3.3–3.6B","People Exposed to\nSevere Hazards","Highly vulnerable\npopulations", ACCENT_DR),
]

gap = 0.010; cw = (CW - gap*6) / 7; ch = 0.108; cy = y - ch

for i, (val, lbl, sub, clr) in enumerate(metrics):
    cx = ML + i*(cw+gap)
    card(ax, cx, cy, cw, ch, ec=clr)
    bar(ax, cx+0.003, cy+ch-0.006, cw-0.006, 0.004, clr)
    vs = 27 if len(val)<=6 else 21 if len(val)<=9 else 18
    T(ax, cx+cw/2, cy+ch-0.015, val, fs=vs, w='bold', c=clr, ha='center', va='top')
    T(ax, cx+cw/2, cy+ch-0.038, lbl, fs=9.5, w='bold', c=TW, ha='center', va='top', ls=1.12)
    T(ax, cx+cw/2, cy+0.008, sub, fs=7.5, c=TD, ha='center', va='bottom', ls=1.1)

y = cy - 0.012

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
#  01 — OBSERVED CHANGES
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
div(ax, y); y -= 0.006
T(ax, ML, y, '01', fs=28, w='bold', c=ACCENT_VM, va='top')
T(ax, ML+0.028, y, 'OBSERVED CHANGES AND CURRENT STATE', fs=17, w='bold', c=TW, va='top')

y -= 0.025
obs = wrap(
    "Human-caused climate change is already affecting every region on Earth, with widespread "
    "and intensifying consequences. Global surface temperature rose ~1.1°C between 2011–2020 "
    "relative to pre-industrial baseline. Atmospheric CO₂ reached 410 ppm in 2019—the highest "
    "in at least 2 million years. Total GHG emissions stood at ~59 GtCO₂e in 2019. Every "
    "region has experienced increases in extreme weather events—heatwaves, heavy precipitation, "
    "droughts, and tropical cyclones—with clear attribution to human influence.", 115)
T(ax, ML, y, obs, fs=11, c=TL, va='top', ls=1.45)

# Data table
y -= 0.090
tbl = [
    ("Global surface temperature rise", "+1.1°C", "2011–2020 vs. 1850–1900"),
    ("Atmospheric CO₂",                  "410 ppm", "2019"),
    ("Global GHG emissions",             "~59 GtCO₂e", "2019"),
    ("Sea level rise",                   "~0.20 m", "1901–2018"),
    ("Arctic sea ice (Sept.) decline",   "~40% area loss", "1979–2020"),
]
cc = [ML, ML+0.27, ML+0.42]
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((ML, y-0.013), CW*0.60, 0.016, boxstyle="round,pad=0.002",
             facecolor=ACCENT_VM, edgecolor='none', alpha=0.2, zorder=2))
for j,(lb,cx) in enumerate(zip(["Indicator","Observed Value","Reference Period"], cc)):
    T(ax, cx+0.006, y-0.008, lb, fs=9.5, w='bold', c=ACCENT_AM, va='center')
y -= 0.019
for i,(ind,val,ref) in enumerate(tbl):
    ry = y - i*0.017
    if i%2==0:
        ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((ML, ry-0.006), CW*0.60, 0.015, boxstyle="round,pad=0.001",
                     facecolor=CARD_BG, edgecolor='none', alpha=0.35, zorder=1))
    T(ax, cc[0]+0.006, ry, ind, fs=9.5, c=TL, va='center')
    T(ax, cc[1]+0.006, ry, val, fs=9.5, w='bold', c=ACCENT_AM, va='center')
    T(ax, cc[2]+0.006, ry, ref, fs=8.5, c=TD, va='center')

y -= len(tbl)*0.017 + 0.010

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
#  02 — FUTURE PROJECTIONS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
div(ax, y); y -= 0.006
T(ax, ML, y, '02', fs=28, w='bold', c=ACCENT_VM, va='top')
T(ax, ML+0.028, y, 'FUTURE PROJECTIONS UNDER DIFFERENT SCENARIOS', fs=17, w='bold', c=TW, va='top')

y -= 0.024
T(ax, ML, y, wrap(
    "The AR6 uses Shared Socioeconomic Pathways (SSPs) to project future climate. "
    "Under SSP1-1.9, warming reaches ~1.4°C by 2100; under SSP5-8.5, warming could "
    "exceed 4.4°C. Sea level is projected to rise 0.28–0.55 m (SSP1-1.9) to 0.63–1.01 m "
    "(SSP5-8.5) by 2100, with continued rise for centuries regardless of pathway.", 115),
  fs=11, c=TL, va='top', ls=1.45)

# SSP Chart
y -= 0.075
cht_h = 0.125; cht_w = CW*0.54; cht_x = ML; cht_y = y - cht_h
card(ax, cht_x, cht_y, cht_w, cht_h, ec=ACCENT_AM, lw=1, bg=DARK_SLATE, al=0.55)

cl = cht_x+0.028; cr = cht_x+cht_w-0.020; cb = cht_y+0.020; ct = cht_y+cht_h-0.015

for t in [1,2,3,4,5]:
    ty = cb + (t/5.0)*(ct-cb)
    ax.add_line(plt.Line2D([cl,cr],[ty,ty], color=TD, linewidth=0.4, alpha=0.25, transform=ax.transAxes, zorder=3))
    T(ax, cl-0.005, ty, f'{t}°C', fs=7.5, c=TD, ha='right', va='center')

t15 = cb + (1.5/5.0)*(ct-cb)
ax.add_line(plt.Line2D([cl,cr],[t15,t15], color=ACCENT_AM, linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.6, linestyle='--', transform=ax.transAxes, zorder=3))
T(ax, cr+0.003, t15, '1.5°C', fs=8, c=ACCENT_AM, va='center', w='bold')
t2 = cb + (2.0/5.0)*(ct-cb)
ax.add_line(plt.Line2D([cl,cr],[t2,t2], color=ACCENT_VM, linewidth=1, alpha=0.4, linestyle='--', transform=ax.transAxes, zorder=3))
T(ax, cr+0.003, t2, '2°C', fs=8, c=ACCENT_VM, va='center')

for yr in [2020,2040,2060,2080,2100]:
    tx = cl + ((yr-2020)/80.0)*(cr-cl)
    T(ax, tx, cb-0.008, str(yr), fs=7.5, c=TD, ha='center', va='top')

T(ax, (cl+cr)/2, cht_y+0.005, 'Global Warming Projections by SSP Scenario',
  fs=8.5, w='bold', c=TL, ha='center', va='bottom')

# Diverging pathway curves
scenarios = [
    ('SSP1-1.9', 1.1, 1.5, 1.4, SC['SSP1-1.9']),
    ('SSP1-2.6', 1.1, 1.6, 1.8, SC['SSP1-2.6']),
    ('SSP2-4.5', 1.1, 1.8, 2.7, SC['SSP2-4.5']),
    ('SSP3-7.0', 1.1, 2.1, 3.6, SC['SSP3-7.0']),
    ('SSP5-8.5', 1.1, 2.5, 4.4, SC['SSP5-8.5']),
]

for nm, t20, t50, t100, clr in scenarios:
    yrs = np.array([2020,2035,2050,2070,2100])
    tmps = np.array([t20, (t20+t50)/2+(t100-t20)*0.15, t50, (t50+t100)/2+(t100-t50)*0.1, t100])
    xs = cl + ((yrs-2020)/80.0)*(cr-cl)
    ys = cb + (tmps/5.0)*(ct-cb)
    lw = 2.5 if '1.9' in nm or '8.5' in nm else 1.8
    for k in range(len(xs)-1):
        ax.add_line(plt.Line2D([xs[k],xs[k+1]],[ys[k],ys[k+1]], color=clr, linewidth=lw, alpha=0.9, transform=ax.transAxes, zorder=4))
    ey = cb + (t100/5.0)*(ct-cb)
    T(ax, cr+0.003, ey, f'{nm}  ~{t100}°C', fs=7, w='bold', c=clr, va='center', ls=1.0)

# Scenario summary table (right)
stx = ML + cht_w + 0.015
T(ax, stx, y, 'Scenario Summary', fs=12, w='bold', c=TW, va='top')

strip = [
    ('SSP1-1.9','~1.4°C','SLR 0.28–0.55 m','Very low emissions', SC['SSP1-1.9']),
    ('SSP1-2.6','~1.8°C','SLR 0.32–0.63 m','Low emissions', SC['SSP1-2.6']),
    ('SSP2-4.5','~2.7°C','SLR 0.44–0.76 m','Intermediate', SC['SSP2-4.5']),
    ('SSP3-7.0','~3.6°C','SLR 0.56–0.98 m','High emissions', SC['SSP3-7.0']),
    ('SSP5-8.5','~4.4°C','SLR 0.63–1.01 m','Fossil-fuel intensive', SC['SSP5-8.5']),
]

sy = y - 0.024; rh = 0.020
for i, (ssp, tmp, slr, desc, clr) in enumerate(strip):
    ry = sy - i*rh
    bar(ax, stx, ry-0.004, 0.004, rh-0.003, clr)
    T(ax, stx+0.008, ry+0.002, ssp, fs=9.5, w='bold', c=clr, va='center')
    T(ax, stx+0.065, ry+0.002, tmp, fs=9.5, w='bold', c=TW, va='center')
    T(ax, stx+0.10, ry+0.002, slr, fs=8, c=TD, va='center')
    T(ax, stx+0.185, ry+0.002, desc, fs=8, c=TD, va='center')

y = cht_y - 0.010

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
#  03 — RISKS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
div(ax, y); y -= 0.006
T(ax, ML, y, '03', fs=28, w='bold', c=ACCENT_VM, va='top')
T(ax, ML+0.028, y, 'RISKS, VULNERABILITIES, AND CASCADING IMPACTS', fs=17, w='bold', c=TW, va='top')

y -= 0.028
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((ML, y-0.028), 0.34, 0.032, boxstyle="round,pad=0.004",
             facecolor=ACCENT_DR, edgecolor='none', alpha=0.35, zorder=2))
T(ax, ML+0.010, y-0.002, '3.3–3.6 billion people', fs=22, w='bold', c=ACCENT_VM, va='top')
T(ax, ML+0.010, y-0.020, 'live in contexts highly vulnerable to climate change', fs=10.5, c=TL, va='top')

# Risk cards
y -= 0.042
rcs = [
    ("FOOD SECURITY","Crop yield growth rates slowed\nin many regions. Fisheries\nproductivity declining in\ntropical zones.", ACCENT_AM),
    ("WATER STRESS","Over half the world's population\nexperiences severe water scarcity\nfor at least one month per year.", COOL_BL),
    ("HEALTH","Heat-related mortality and\nvector-borne disease ranges\nare expanding with rising\ntemperatures.", ACCENT_VM),
]
rcg = 0.010; rcw = (CW-rcg*2)/3; rch = 0.060
for i, (t, d, clr) in enumerate(rcs):
    cx = ML + i*(rcw+rcg)
    card(ax, cx, y-rch, rcw, rch, ec=clr)
    bar(ax, cx+0.003, y-0.003, rcw-0.006, 0.004, clr)
    T(ax, cx+0.010, y-0.012, t, fs=11, w='bold', c=clr, va='top')
    T(ax, cx+0.010, y-0.024, d, fs=8.5, c=TL, va='top', ls=1.3)

y -= rch + 0.010
T(ax, ML, y, wrap(
    "Biodiversity loss accelerates beyond 1.5°C — up to 14% of terrestrial species face very high "
    "extinction risk at 1.5°C, rising sharply at higher levels. Climate hazards interact with "
    "non-climatic stressors—poverty, inequality, ecosystem degradation—to produce cascading "
    "and compounding risks.", 120),
  fs=10.5, c=TL, va='top', ls=1.4)

y -= 0.050

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
#  04 — MITIGATION
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
div(ax, y); y -= 0.006
T(ax, ML, y, '04', fs=28, w='bold', c=ACCENT_VM, va='top')
T(ax, ML+0.028, y, 'MITIGATION AND ADAPTATION PATHWAYS', fs=17, w='bold', c=TW, va='top')

y -= 0.025
pw = [
    ("1.5°C PATHWAY","43% reduction by 2030","Net zero CO₂ by ~2050", ACCENT_VM, "~500 GtCO₂ remaining budget (50% likelihood)"),
    ("2°C PATHWAY","27% reduction by 2030","Net zero CO₂ by ~2070", ACCENT_AM, "Larger but still constrained carbon budget"),
]
pg = 0.012; pcw = (CW-pg)/2; pch = 0.058
for i, (t, t1, t2, clr, bgt) in enumerate(pw):
    cx = ML + i*(pcw+pg)
    card(ax, cx, y-pch, pcw, pch, ec=clr, lw=2)
    T(ax, cx+0.012, y-0.006, t, fs=13, w='bold', c=clr, va='top')
    T(ax, cx+0.012, y-0.020, t1, fs=11.5, w='bold', c=TW, va='top')
    T(ax, cx+0.012, y-0.032, t2, fs=11.5, w='bold', c=TW, va='top')
    T(ax, cx+0.012, y-0.048, bgt, fs=9, c=TD, va='top')

y -= pch + 0.012
T(ax, ML, y, 'Key Mitigation Levers', fs=12, w='bold', c=COOL_TL, va='top')
y -= 0.016
levers = ["Rapid decarbonization\nof energy systems","Electrification\nof transport",
          "Demand-side efficiency\nimprovements","Protection & restoration\nof carbon sinks"]
lg = 0.008; lvw = (CW-lg*3)/4; lvh = 0.025
for i, lv in enumerate(levers):
    lx = ML + i*(lvw+lg)
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((lx, y-lvh), lvw, lvh, boxstyle="round,pad=0.003",
                facecolor=COOL_TL, edgecolor='none', alpha=0.12, zorder=2))
    T(ax, lx+lvw/2, y-lvh/2, lv, fs=9, c=COOL_TL, ha='center', va='center', w='bold', ls=1.15)

y -= lvh + 0.012

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
#  05 — NARROWING WINDOW
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
div(ax, y, clr=ACCENT_RD, a=0.5, lw=2); y -= 0.006
T(ax, ML, y, '05', fs=28, w='bold', c=ACCENT_RD, va='top')
T(ax, ML+0.028, y, 'THE NARROWING WINDOW FOR ACTION', fs=17, w='bold', c=ACCENT_RD, va='top')

y -= 0.025
T(ax, ML, y, wrap(
    "The choices made in this decade will determine whether warming can be held to 1.5°C or 2°C. "
    "Delayed action increases costs, locks in high-carbon infrastructure, and reduces feasibility. "
    "Climate finance flows remain insufficient—falling short by a factor of 3 to 6 for adaptation alone.", 115),
  fs=11, c=TL, va='top', ls=1.45)

# Urgency callout
y -= 0.060
uh = 0.055
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((ML, y-uh), CW, uh, boxstyle="round,pad=0.007",
             facecolor=ACCENT_RD, edgecolor=ACCENT_VM, linewidth=2.5, alpha=0.22, zorder=2))
T(ax, ML+CW/2, y-0.010,
  'Immediate, deep, and sustained emissions reductions\nacross all sectors are essential to secure a\nliveable and sustainable future for all.',
  fs=15, w='bold', c=TW, ha='center', va='top', ls=1.45)
T(ax, ML+CW/2, y-0.042,
  'Climate finance falls short by a factor of 3–6 for adaptation alone',
  fs=11, c=ACCENT_AM, ha='center', va='center', w='bold')

# Carbon budget bars
y -= uh + 0.010
T(ax, ML, y, 'Remaining Carbon Budget Window', fs=11, w='bold', c=TW, va='top')
y -= 0.015
bd = [("2020",500,1.0),("2030",310,0.62),("2040",160,0.32),("2050",50,0.10)]
bmw = CW*0.60; bh = 0.016
for i, (dec, gtc, frac) in enumerate(bd):
    by = y - i*(bh+0.005)
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((ML,by), bmw, bh, boxstyle="round,pad=0.002",
                facecolor=DARK_SLATE, edgecolor='none', alpha=0.5, zorder=2))
    bc = ACCENT_AM if frac>0.3 else ACCENT_VM if frac>0.15 else ACCENT_RD
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((ML,by), bmw*frac, bh, boxstyle="round,pad=0.002",
                facecolor=bc, edgecolor='none', alpha=0.8, zorder=3))
    T(ax, ML+0.005, by+bh/2, dec, fs=9, w='bold', c=TW, va='center')
    T(ax, ML+bmw+0.008, by+bh/2, f'~{gtc} GtCO₂ remaining', fs=9, c=TD, va='center')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
#  FOOTER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
fy = 0.022
ax.add_line(plt.Line2D([ML, ML+CW], [fy+0.012, fy+0.012], color=ACCENT_AM, linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.3, transform=ax.transAxes, zorder=3))
T(ax, ML, fy,
  'Source: IPCC, 2023. AR6 Synthesis Report: Climate Change 2023. Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change.',
  fs=8.5, c=TD, va='bottom')
T(ax, ML+CW, fy, 'Climate Change 2023  |  IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report',
  fs=8.5, c=TD, ha='right', va='bottom', w='bold')

# ── Save ──
out = '/app/output/final_poster.png'
fig.savefig(out, dpi=DPI, facecolor=fig.get_facecolor(), pad_inches=0.15)
plt.close(fig)
print(f'Poster saved to {out}')

img = Image.open(out)
print(f'Dimensions: {img.size[0]}x{img.size[1]} pixels')
print(f'Aspect ratio: {img.size[0]/img.size[1]:.3f} (A0 portrait = {841/1189:.3f})')
print(f'File size: {round(os.path.getsize(out)/1024/1024, 2)} MB')
